topic: Computer Vision and Convolutional Neural Networks
learningObjectives: Understand how images are represented as numerical data
Explain the purpose of convolution and pooling layers
Trace how a CNN extracts visual features

activities.title: Image as Data
activities.instruction: Click image regions to explore pixels and channels.

content.concept: Digital images are represented as numerical pixel values organized across spatial dimensions and color channels.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Convolution Explorer
activities.instruction: Move the filter across the image to observe feature extraction.

content.concept: Convolution applies a learnable filter across an image to detect local patterns such as edges and textures.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: CNN Architecture
activities.instruction: Build a CNN using convolution, pooling, and dense layers.

content.concept: CNNs combine convolutional feature extraction with later layers that use extracted features for prediction.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Vision Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps from image input to classification.

content.concept: A computer vision pipeline can transform an image into learned features and then use those features for classification.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
